content.title: Olive Garden Italian Restaurant | Family Style Dining | Italian Food
content.text: Frequently Asked Questions Restaurant Info What are the hours of operation for Olive Garden? Olive Garden hours may vary by location. Please find your nearest restaurant to see hours of operation. Lunch is served Monday through Friday until 3pm. Our practice is to serve our dinner menu all day on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays. There are some regional variations. Find your nearest Olive Garden Location now! Holiday Hours Olive Garden restaurants are closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day to allow our team members to spend time with their family and friends. Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam and International holiday hours may vary by location. Depending on the amount of business on the day before these holidays, the restaurants may close early. We leave this decision to the discretion of the management team. Please contact the restaurant directly for the scheduled closing time the day before Thanksgiving or Christmas Eve. Find your nearest Olive Garden Location now! What is the current promotion? Are there any specials? To be the first to find out about promotions, specials, and news sign up to our eClub! You can also check out our Specials Page for current offers! Does Olive Garden offer catering? Our Catering Menu features generous family-sized Italian meals available for pickup that make party planning easy. So, for your next family dinner, special party or office gathering let Olive Garden help you delight guests with delicious Italian specialties. For your convenience, we now offer delivery of Catering orders $100 or greater. All orders are subject to a 10% delivery fee up to $500, then 5% for every dollar thereafter. Learn more about Catering Delivery. Where will you be building future Olive Garden restaurants? Check out our future Olive Garden restaurants. These are updated constantly, so check anytime for the latest information. Actual locations and opening dates are subject to change. If your city is not listed, we hope to be coming soon! Where do I fill out a survey of my visit? You may take a brief survey on our Ziosk tableside tablet after your meal. For takeout orders and at our Canadian restaurants, there is a unique code on your receipt which is needed in order to complete a survey. Do you offer group discounts? Rather than offer a discount to one particular group of guests, we believe our responsibility is to make sure we're providing the best dining value possible to every guest who joins us for lunch or dinner. Is there a free birthday offer in the restaurant? Olive Garden guests can receive a complimentary dessert on their birthday when they dine with us. To receive other great offers, simply sign up for our eClub and be sure to include information like your birthdate and address so we can keep you updated on the latest Olive Garden news and send you special coupons for your local Olive Garden. Will servers sing Happy Birthday? Thank you for considering us for your celebrations! Our team members would be happy to join your group in singing Happy Birthday to the guest of honor. Does Olive Garden have a rewards program? We currently do not offer a rewards program, but you can sign up for our Eclub in order to receive news & offers. What safety measures are you taking in your restaurants? The health and safety of our guests and team members has always been our first priority. That is why we have a dedicated team of Total Quality experts responsible for overseeing our robust food safety and restaurant cleanliness practices. Along with our participation in the ServSafe Dining Commitment, we are confident in our ability to provide a safe environment for our guests and team members. Learn More. Is your salad dressing available for purchase? Yes! You can purchase our signature salad dressing from your local Olive Garden or find our signature dressing at a retailer near you. Other Olive Garden products, like our Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Balsamic Vinegar, Italian Seasoning, and select cheeses, are also available for purchase nationwide at wholesale and grocery retailers. How do I sell a recipe to Olive Garden? While we delight in accepting menu suggestions, we cannot accept recipes. We work closely with our chefs to bring the freshest, most flavorful dishes inspired by Italy to our restaurants. Do your oils contain trans fat? Our cooking oils do not contain trans fat. Gift Cards How can I purchase your Gift Cards? How can I check the status of my gift card order? You can check the status of your order by calling 1-800-248-4935 between the hours of 9am and 8pm EST or emailing giftcardservices@gift.olivegarden.com. How do I get the balance on my Gift Card? You can check your balance online or call the phone number on the back of your card and follow the instructions. Does Olive Garden offer discounts on gift card purchases? Discounts are offered on purchases of gift cards on the following amounts:$500-999: 5% discount$1000 & More: 10% discountCall our Gift Card Center to order these discounted cards: 800-248-4935 (US), 888-888-3341 (Canada) between 9am and 8pm EST. How long does it take for me to receive my order once its placed? Orders are typically fulfilled within 2 business days and mailed via your chosen method USPS Orders are typically received with 10-12 Business Days UPS 2nd Day Orders are typically received within 4-5 Business Days UPS Next Day orders are typically received within 3 Business Days To Go Does Olive Garden offer online ordering for To Go? For your convenience we offer online ordering for To Go at most of our locations. View our To Go menu here. I need to cancel or change my To Go order. Please contact the restaurant directly if you need to change or cancel your To Go order. Your confirmation email will have the phone number to your local Olive Garden. Merchandise Does Olive Garden sell merchandise? From time-to-time Olive Garden may release merchandise collections with items available for purchase. Sign up for the Olive Garden eClub to be the first to hear about what’s new, receive coupons and more. Donations How do I make a request for a donation? Olive Garden donates to charitable causes that benefit the community. Donation requests can be submitted in writing to the general manager of your local Olive Garden. This includes requests for donations of gift certificates or food. Request should be on your organization's official letterhead, including the organizations full name, address, phone and fax numbers. State your donation request, when it is needed and how it will benefit the community. Please submit written requests 30 days prior to the date the donation is needed. Unfortunately, it's not possible to honor every request that we receive. Please accept our apology in advance if we are not able to fulfill your request. Employment How can I apply for a job at Olive Garden? We are always looking for new members of the Olive Garden family. Please check our Career Opportunities page to learn more and to apply online for both Management and Team Member positions at any Olive Garden Restaurant. For information about management positions and employment at the Restaurant Support Center, click here. How can I apply for a job at a new location? We are pleased to know you are considering employment with Olive Garden. About 30 days before the restaurant opens there will be a banner at the restaurant indicating that the restaurant is "Now Hiring." You can apply online after that sign is posted. For opening dates, visit our Coming Soon or call us at 1-888-221-0642. Our office hours are Monday-Friday, 10:00 a.m.- 4:00 p.m. EST. Employment Verification Contact our vendor, The Work Number, at 800-367-2884 or via the company's website, www.theworknumber.com. Our Employer Code is 11533. Employee Information If you're looking for information pertaining to your own employment, please contact the following departments directly by telephone. Benefits: (888) 374-3343 Payroll: (407) 245-4400 Employee Relations: (800) 932-2558 Corporate Information Does Olive Garden offer franchise opportunities? Click here to learn more about restaurant franchising. Where can I obtain an annual report? You may download an annual report by visiting the Investor Relations section of our parent company's website, Darden Restaurants (www.darden.com). What is Olive Garden's Stock Ticker Symbol? Olive Garden's parent company, Darden Restaurants, Inc. stock is traded on the NYSE under code DRI. Student Information Thanks for thinking of Olive Garden for your school project. Our website, (and the website of our parent company, Darden Restaurants), contains valuable information that may be incorporated into your school presentation. Please browse the information available and use the material for your project. Real Estate If you have questions or comments about the sale or purchase of real estate, please contact our Real Estate Department at (407) 245-4555. Advertising Vendor Inquiries All Media proposals are coordinated by Havas Media in New York at 212-886-4100. How has the Olive Garden logo changed over time? We strive to provide a dining experience in a warm and inviting setting for every guest we serve. Our logo evolution is a reflection of the Italian generosity guests have enjoyed from Olive Garden since we first opened our doors in 1982. While our look may have changed a bit over the years, our guests continue to rely on Olive Garden to host memorable dining experiences with those who matter most.
